usage: icebath mcp [-h]
                   {add,remove,rm,list,ls,test,configure,config,login,reauth,picker,catalog,install} ...

Manage MCP server connections. MCP servers provide additional tools via the Model Context
Protocol. Use 'icebath mcp add' to connect to a new server. Running Icebath itself as an MCP
server is the mcp-serve plugin: `icebath plugins install mcp-serve`.

positional arguments:
  {add,remove,rm,list,ls,test,configure,config,login,reauth,picker,catalog,install}
    add                 Add an MCP server (discovery-first install)
    remove (rm)         Remove an MCP server
    list (ls)           List configured MCP servers
    test                Test MCP server connection
    configure (config)  Toggle tool selection
    login               Force re-authentication for an OAuth-based MCP server
    reauth              Re-authenticate one OAuth MCP server, or all of them (--all)
    picker              Interactive catalog picker (also the default for `icebath mcp`)
    catalog             List Nous-approved MCPs available for one-click install
    install             Install a catalog MCP by name (e.g. `icebath mcp install deepwiki`)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
